findings.title: Sensitive value may reach an exception
evidence: The synthetic exception path receives an unredacted input.
findings.impact: A caller could expose sensitive input through logs.
findings.suggestion: Raise a fixed message and redact caller context.

findings.title: Integer callers now receive a float
evidence: The added division always uses true division.
findings.impact: Downstream equality checks can change behavior.
findings.suggestion: Preserve the documented numeric return type.
